contract: ../ui-contract.md: 0.1.1 canvas-first editor, host theme variables, categorized top controls, transparent selection, predictable zoom and annotation transforms; actual host qualification is separate.

accessibility.evidence: Visible labeled top controls and non-drag named-pin/numeric transform alternatives remain available. Native browser drags verify selection and annotation operations; the 0.1.1 browser reviews cover both target sizes. Complete screen-reader/device qualification remains pending.

responsive.evidence: Both target sizes use a full-width canvas with no page overflow. Parts appear only in a categorized preview popup; Properties opens on request. On phone widths the top controls can scroll horizontally.

loading.reason: The standalone Editor receives a validated document synchronously and has no asynchronous document fetch state. Actual Obsidian file loading remains outside this browser-only review and is explicitly untested in validation.md.

empty.evidence: The blank editor is a plain canvas with usable top toolbar controls. The nonfunctional introductory button and its surrounding copy were removed; category selection and placement were exercised.

error.evidence: Malformed and future JSON import display a specific dialog error and preserve the existing circuit, verified at both target viewports.

partial.reason: The version-1 editor refuses partially valid imports; graph/schema validation is atomic. Unsupported host files use raw recovery rather than a partial editable drawing; that host-only view is not claimed tested here.

success.evidence: 0.1.1 reviews verify top-toolbar selection, fixed zoom stops, annotation transforms/export and exact transform undo. finish-native.json confirms a single wire and no trailing pointer-up action.

permission.reason: This editor has no account, network access or runtime authorization prompt. System clipboard is optional and retains an in-editor/text-copy alternative. Actual platform clipboard denial remains a separate manual check, not a claimed pass.

renderedEvidence.observation: Full-width neutral dark canvas; no brand banner or permanent palette; colors are inherited from supplied host variables.
The same editor follows light host variables without changing document content.
Categorized toolbar popup with nine passive part previews rather than the entire library in a column.
Phone canvas retains its width, compact top controls and zoom/fit; no document overflow.
